boundaryDecisions: Affirmative architectural recommendation for genuine Scheme-to-Zig native generation and shared system services; no implemented backend, native profile or accepted economic gate
Scheme retains language/constructor/root/control meaning and negotiates target resource costs before immutable completion; raw GVM or translated generated C is insufficient
TailHostProfile and explicit DispatchHostProfile are distinct whole-cohort control/module/frame designs; no silent fallback or arbitrary C nonlocal transfer across Zig frames
Zig source generation and independent MLIR/LLVM native provider share runtime contracts without requiring a Zig-source or internal Zig LLVM API path
AllocationCheckSpec binds actual ordered writes and formed addresses/minima/provenance, current assurance, pending operations, target size and all helper/materialization effects
Rebase-free high-water summaries compose with net cursor offsets; guard-sensitive excess above L differs from total relative-to-h work; counter resets never erase high-water or pending body writes
Selected conditional arithmetic gives 64-bit no-handles pair 3 words, allocated box 2 words and vector n+1+2*d; isolated dynamic small allocation extent is <=255, not a whole-program bound
Tentative dynamic probes require native allocation provenance and logical interval permission even before body writes; integer-only checked offsets are a separately admitted realization
Floating cache versions and actual pre/post-check box events remain distinct from planned potential boxes; NAN/self-tagged/32-bit alignment profiles change actual cost/layout
Rest/key finish-before-GC needs actual complete-frame/contiguous capacity protocol; conditional independent-maxima 25601-word arithmetic is not a reachable-state or native-overflow witness
Immutable plan/layout recipes and actual span/completion/root publication are different authorities; dense complete runs can compact metadata while sparse/partial exceptions retain explicit custody
Generated modern C/C-ZT reuse and common LLVM/compiler value are credited before any Zig increment; old authority/work must truly retire and complete added costs remain unbounded
